selection_data: Exposed observer development split 2026095402. V2 accepts 222/225 present states with 3.240 mm p95 and 8.094 mm maximum error. Three-view cases alone have 2.470 mm p95; two-view cases have 4.687 mm p95.
change: Require all three confident views, reprojection residual at most 1.5 pixels, and the known 103 mm axis length within 6 mm. This is a conservative observation refusal rule, not improved neural accuracy on the same images.

physical_trace_diagnostic: Exposed seed-42 bottle motion, all 256 evenly spaced observations. Score current RGB detections against simulator keypoints outside the observer. This is perception evaluation on physical motion, not corrective control.
acceptance: Report all refusals and false detections. Target accepted maximum-keypoint 3D error p95 below 3 mm. Do not further tune on the fresh observer evaluation; preserve it even if it fails. Physical evaluation seeds 2026095301-2026095312 remain unexposed.
